verses.text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
lines: God, you are my God.
I will earnestly seek you.
My soul thirsts for you.
My flesh longs for you,
in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

verses.text: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
lines: So I have seen you in the sanctuary,
watching your power and your glory.

verses.text: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
lines: Because your loving kindness is better than life,
my lips shall praise you.

verses.text: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
lines: So I will bless you while I live.
I will lift up my hands in your name.

verses.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
lines: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food.
My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

verses.text: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
lines: when I remember you on my bed,
and think about you in the night watches.

verses.text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
lines: For you have been my help.
I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

verses.text: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
lines: My soul stays close to you.
Your right hand holds me up.

verses.text: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
lines: But those who seek my soul to destroy it
shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
lines: They shall be given over to the power of the sword.
They shall be jackal food.

verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
lines: But the king shall rejoice in God.
Everyone who swears by him will praise him,
for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
